name: Last Second Save
source:
Last Second Save is a "what if" scenario for Ending 1 of Snoot Game.  Anon, influenced by the harsh words of Naomi, realizes his approach to helping Fang was a bust after the disastrous prom night. Instead of distracting himself with video games, he sits down with Fang and, to the best of his abilities, comforts her.

Alas, he can't undo the damage that's already been done. Doesn't mean he won't try.

[From [url=https://snoot-talk.itch.io/lastsecondsave]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
最后一秒保存是Snoot Game结局1的“假设”场景。阿农受到内奥米严厉言论的影响，在灾难性的舞会之夜后意识到他帮助方的方法失败了。他没有用电子游戏来分散自己的注意力，而是和方坐在一起，尽其所能地安慰她。

唉，他无法挽回已经造成的伤害。并不意味着他不会尝试。

[来自[url=https://snoot-talk.itch.io/lastsecondsave]Itch.io[/url]]
